passage.text: During the safe and enjoyable outdoor summer activities unit, Booha and Nuppi focus first on “outdoor picnic.” They discuss “nature hike” and consider “campfire gathering” with their teacher. By the end of the lesson, everyone understands that preparation, reflection, and cooperation strengthen learning.
